# The seams grizzle's main replaces

den is pinned on grizzle's `main`, into which `live` merged, so every commit below is in its pin. CLASH (`schema()`
takes a list, `lower/merge.ts` deleted) and LIVE-SOURCE (the suites' decoder grant deleted) are taken; den still takes
the rest, each from the grizzle session's report:

Leases, due instants and windows are judged by the database's clock: den's caller-clock seam is deleted. Clocked reads serve `once` and no `watch`, which matches den's split: the relay's watch reads what commits made eligible, without time; the census reads what time made eligible, as a clocked `once` || 1cc5b113 | CARRIER | no delta in a temporary table: a read-back of a delta runs inside the statement that makes it, met included; any other read-back is refused at compile as `ReadBackCrossesStatements`, naming its rewrite. A queue claim compiled on it: 14 → 9 statements and 4 → 2 temporary tables (mutable work), 17 → 12 and 5 → 3 (immutable). den's claim and commit read-backs must take the rewrite each refusal names || 28496788 | LEASE | `race(R)`, a schema rule beside `mutable`: a raced table's inserts arbitrate at its primary key, and the loser meets the stored fact; refused on a mutable relation, a whole-heading or span key, a drawn primary-key field, a family's owner or member, a derived relation. The certifier counts a winner read after a clean arbitration as arbitrated, and expiry is a new fact (`at + ttl < now`, DBCLOCK's `now`). den's claim and seat relations become raced, and the seat module (SERIALIZABLE at `a226cbac`) moves to READ COMMITTED; adding or dropping `race` is a fingerprint-only migration, after which an old Db answers `StaleSnapshot` |
| 3f679040 | DELTAMET's tests | met over four shapes at READ COMMITTED and SERIALIZABLE; a write skew through a met row fails 40001; the in-flight entry race is refused on the key's law || e8c08aa7 | DEFERRABLE | `deferrable(read)`, per member, on a query, ordered query, paged read or key: its reads run SERIALIZABLE READ ONLY DEFERRABLE and never fail with 40001 (a deadlock is their only transient). den's census and its declared step reads become deferrable || e509252a, 9a2af8c5 | POROUS | `fragment(relations, statements)`: a nameless library fragment, identified by its content, listed in an app's `schema()` or `schema.extend()` list and a level of every schema that lists it. Programs written once over the fragment compile per host at generate, served byte-identical to their host twin. Every write-deciding statement over a fragment relation (key, mutable, race, retirable, family, tree, fold) is the fragment's own; a host adds only refusals; a role holds the fragment whole to serve its programs. den's `lower/print.ts` and `merge.ts` seams are deleted: den exports `fragment([...])`, and the app lists it. Open at the repin: how a step's commit, den's fragment facts plus the app's own writes in one call, is written as a host program over the fragment and the app's relations |
